title: Add invocation cohort tiler and synthetic token fingerprint
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Add a cohort tiler to group invocations by token-distribution shape and introduce a lightweight synthetic token fingerprint metric for long-tail cost attribution. Improves SLO debugging and reduces alert noise by enabling cohort-based baselines.
description:
Context and motivation: We see frequent noisy SLO alerts that stem from heterogeneous invocation shapes (short chat turns vs. long generation tails) which dilute signal when aggregated. This PR introduces an invocation cohort tiler that classifies invocations into a small set of stable cohorts at ingestion time and a synthetic token fingerprint (a compact, privacy-preserving sketch of token shape) that can be used for low-cardinality cost attributions in dashboards and alert rules.

What this change does: Adds cohort assignment logic in the observability ingestion path, exposes cohort labels on metrics and traces, and generates a 64-bit token fingerprint that summarizes prompt/response token-length histogram and entropy. It also adds a Grafana panel and alert rule tweaks that use cohort baselines for SLO evaluation.

Checklist: - [x] Instrument cohort assignment in telemetry pipeline - [x] Propagate cohort as metric label and trace tag - [x] Add synthetic fingerprint field to invocation metadata (non-PII, hashed) - [x] Grafana panels and alert rule updates - [x] Unit and integration tests for tiler and fingerprint generator - [x] E2E dry-run in staging for one week

Commits (summary): 1) initial cohort-tiler prototype and unit tests; 2) wire cohort label through ingestion path and metrics exporter; 3) add fingerprint generator + tests; 4) Grafana dashboard and alert rule changes; 5) fix sampler edge-case and test flakiness; 6) squash and polish.

Changed/high-level files: - observability/ingest/cohort_tiler.py: new cohorting logic and config (approx 300 LOC) - observability/ingest/fingerprint.py: synthetic fingerprint sketch and hashing helpers - observability/exporter/metrics_exporter.go: attach cohort label and fingerprint as metric labels (low-cardinality policy applied) - tracing/propagator/trace_tags.go: add trace tag for cohort - infra/grafana/dashboards/invocation_cohort_overview.json: new dashboard panel and queries - infra/grafana/alerts/cohort_slo_rules.yaml: updated alerting rules to evaluate baselines per-cohort - telemetry/tests/test_cohort_tiler.py: python unit tests - telemetry/tests/test_fingerprint.py: property tests

Small code snippets (illustrative): - cohort assignment: "cohort = tiler.assign(shape_hash, token_counts)" - fingerprint generation: "fingerprint = fingerprint_sketch(token_counts).compact64()"

Review conversation (high level): - Alex Chen: "Nice isolation. One ask: ensure cohort labels obey our low-cardinality policy; prefer bucketed cohort IDs (cohort_0..cohort_7) rather than free hashes." - Author (Priya): "Done — tiler now maps into fixed 8 buckets; updated tests and exporter labeling to use canonical cohort ids." - Maya Patel: "Can we run a staging replay against last 7 days to confirm alert reduction?" - Author: "Ran dry-run in staging for 7 days; alerts fell ~42% on noisy SLOs; attached replay metrics in the PR." - Samir Gupta: "Minor nit: add a comment in metrics_exporter explaining label cardinality rationale." - Author: "Added comment and small refactor." - Final: Alex approved, Maya approved with comment, Samir approved.

CI and validation: All checks passed after two reruns. Unit tests coverage +2.1% in observability package. Integration test: ingestion pipeline with sample traffic in staging (3M invocations) validated cohort distribution and ensured no PII present in fingerprints. Lint and go vet clean.

Operational notes and rollout plan: - Feature gate behind config: telemetry.cohort_tiler.enabled=false by default. - Staged rollout: enable for 10% of production tenant traffic -> 50% -> 100% over 72 hours, monitor invocation-cohort-distribution and SLO alert rate. - Alert tuning: new cohort-aware SLO rule uses per-cohort historical baseline with a 30-day warmup. Old rules are left as fallback and silenced once cohorts are stable. - Rollback plan: flip telemetry.cohort_tiler.enabled=false and redeploy ingestion workers; fingerprinting is additive and should be safe to disable.

Risks and mitigations: - Risk: accidental high-cardinality labels. Mitigation: cohort bucketing to 8 fixed ids, enforced in exporter and validated by unit tests. - Risk: fingerprint could leak prompt structure. Mitigation: design is sketch-based, uses aggregated token-length histogram and one-way hash; security reviewed by privacy team (SUP-1345).

Follow-ups: - Add cohort-aware sampling to span sampling policy (follow-up PR). - Investigate cohort-aware cost predictions in Optimize product.
